name: Connective Tissue Disorder Due to Lysyl Hydroxylase-3 Deficiency

criteria.description: Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the PLOD3 gene
Presence of connective tissue manifestations including joint hypermobility, skin fragility, and craniofacial abnormalities
Reduced lysyl hydroxylase-3 enzymatic activity in fibroblasts or cultured cells

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Biallelic pathogenic variants in PLOD3 plus presence of characteristic clinical features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is confirmed primarily by genetic testing; biochemical and clinical findings support diagnosis.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe joint hypermobility with recurrent dislocations
searchTerms: loose joints that pop out often

pathognomonic.symptomName: Skin hyperextensibility with easy bruising and fragility
Characteristic craniofacial dysmorphism including micrognathia and midface hypoplasia
searchTerms: distinct facial features like small jaw
unusual face shape with underdeveloped midface

common.symptomName: Congenital heart defects including valve abnormalities
searchTerms: heart valve problems present at birth

occasional.symptomName: Hearing loss due to ossicular chain abnormalities
searchTerms: hearing loss from middle ear bone problems
middle ear bone malformations affecting hearing

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory complications including restrictive lung disease
searchTerms: difficulty breathing due to lung restriction

laboratory: Reduced lysyl hydroxylase-3 enzymatic activity in cultured fibroblasts
Abnormal collagen cross-linking patterns on biochemical assays
imaging: Echocardiography showing valve abnormalities and possible aortic root dilation
Skeletal X-rays demonstrating joint subluxations and scoliosis
other: Histopathology of skin biopsy showing abnormal collagen fibril morphology

distinguishingFeatures: More prominent skin hyperextensibility with atrophic scarring
Marked congenital hypotonia and early-onset kyphoscoliosis
Elevated urinary lysyl pyridinoline to hydroxylysyl pyridinoline ratio

redFlags: Congenital heart defects with valve insufficiency
Severe skin fragility with recurrent wounds and poor healing
references: Syx D, Malfait F, et al. PLOD3 mutations cause a connective tissue disorder with vascular complications. Am J Hum Genet. 2015.
Orphanet: Connective tissue disorder due to lysyl hydroxylase-3 deficiency. ORPHA:300284.
Malfait F, et al. The molecular basis of connective tissue disorders: lysyl hydroxylase-3 deficiency. Clin Genet. 2017.
